title: Level 11 (The Endless City)
note: review/baseline/11 was reshot in B12 on a build of unchanged main (the B0 set is kept as 11-b0; it matched within 2.5 levels). B12 re-spotted the black refuge shots as inspection shots and added close spots for each façade style, the diner's front and inside, the billboard from its roof, a street light, a bench, the cracked asphalt and a subway station.
